name: OpenCut
one_liner: A free, open-source alternative to CapCut for editing short videos, currently being rebuilt with automation and plugin support on the roadmap.
buyer: A solo content creator or small social-media team who wants CapCut-style editing without subscription fees or watermarks.
business_use_cases: A content creator uses the current 'classic' version as a free CapCut replacement for daily short-form editing.
A developer builds a narrow, branded editor for one niche (e.g. real-estate listing videos) once the plugin API ships.
An agency offers managed cloud-rendering for creators without powerful editing hardware, once headless mode ships.

money_ideas.idea: Fork the stable 'classic' version into a narrow, vertical-specific editor and sell it as a subscription SaaS.
Once the plugin architecture ships, sell premium plugins/templates through a marketplace.
Offer a one-off 'set up your free video editor' service for creators intimidated by the open-source install process.

steal_this: This weekend, fork the current 'classic' OpenCut, strip it down to one workflow (e.g. real-estate listing videos with branded templates), and sell seats to local agents.
